content: Common pitfalls/disclaimers across debloat tool ecosystems: explicit 'not guaranteed reversible' warnings, ARM/ARM64 incompatibility call-outs, and community guidance to always snapshot before running. Five recurring failure modes reported: WebView2/Edge breakage, accidental removal of useful apps, crippled Microsoft Store/app-install experience, disabled core services causing instability, and tampering with Windows Update/servicing leaving the machine unpatchable.
